keyword: how does the play in tournament work
claims: The 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament is April 14–17.
The 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament determines the 7th and 8th playoff seeds for each conference.
The 2026 NBA Play-In Tournament features teams ranked 7th through 10th.
The winner of the 7th vs. 8th game is the #7 seed.
The winner of the 9th vs. 10th game plays the loser of the 7/8 game for the #8 seed.
Teams 7-8 get two chances to win one game.
